interval_years.quote: The division shall issue each license under this chapter in accordance with a two-year renewal cycle established by division rule.

required.quote: Prior to license renewal, each licensee shall, during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by division rule: ... (b) complete qualified continuing professional education requirements as defined by division rule made in collaboration with the board.

period_years.quote: during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by division rule

available.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state
available.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

requirements.value: Applicant must have been licensed in another state with similar scope of practice, at least one year of experience, and license in good standing; or meet substantially similar requirements.
requirements.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing
requirements.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

exists.quote: "Board" means the Medical Licensing Board created in Section 58-67-201.

national_certification.value: National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA)
national_certification.quote: Utilize passage of a recognized national exam such as the NCCPA PANCE as a requirement for PA licensure.
national_certification.citation: Section 103 - Section 3 -- State Participation in this Compact.

is_mandatory.quote: A license is required to engage in practice as a physician assistant, except as specifically provided in Section 58-70a-305 or 58-1-307.

title_protection.quote: A physician assistant, while practicing as a physician assistant: (a) shall wear an identification badge showing the physician assistant's license classification as a physician assistant; (b) shall identify themselves to a patient as a physician assistant; and (c) may not identify themselves to any person in connection with activities allowed under this chapter other than as a physician assistant or PA.

scope_protection.quote: A license is required to engage in practice as a physician assistant, except as specifically provided in Section 58-70a-305 or 58-1-307.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined by statute or rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has engaged in unprofessional conduct, as defined by statute or rule under this title
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unlawful conduct as defined by statute
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has engaged in unlawful conduct as defined by statute under this title
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Determined to be mentally incompetent by a court
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee has been determined to be mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, substance use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the applicant or licensee is unable to practice the occupation or profession with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, drunkenness, excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other type of material, or as a result of a mental or physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.citation: UMBRELLA / Chapter 1 - Division of Professional Licensing Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of patient confidence to unauthorized persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of a patient confidence to any person who does not have a legal right and a professional need to know the information concerning the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly prescribing or administering prescription drugs without legitimate medical purpose
disciplinary_grounds.quote: knowingly prescribing, selling, giving away, or directly or indirectly administering, or offering to prescribe, sell, furnish, give away, or administer any prescription drug except for a legitimate medical purpose upon a proper diagnosis

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing or administering prescription drugs to oneself outside of a legitimate prescription
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribing prescription drugs for oneself or administering prescription drugs to oneself, except those that have been legally prescribed for the physician assistant by a licensed practitioner

disciplinary_grounds.description: In a PA-owned practice, failing to allow a physician independent final decision-making authority on treatment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: in a practice that has physician assistant ownership interests, failure to allow a physician the independent final decision making authority on treatment decisions for the physician's patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating dispensing requirements of pharmacy law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating the dispensing requirements of Chapter 17b, Part 8, Dispensing Medical Practitioner and Dispensing Medical Practitioner Clinic Pharmacy, if applicable

disciplinary_grounds.description: Falsely making or altering a medical record to conceal wrongful conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: falsely making an entry in, or altering, a medical record with the intent to conceal: (i) a wrongful or negligent act or omission of an individual licensed under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating requirements of the Cannabinoid Research and Medical Cannabis chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating the requirements of Title 26B, Chapter 4, Part 2, Cannabinoid Research and Medical Cannabis

disciplinary_grounds.description: Designating a child as do not resuscitate without parental consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: designating a child as do not resuscitate without parental consent

definition_quote.value: Practice as a physician assistant means the professional activities and conduct of a physician assistant, also known as a PA, in diagnosing, treating, advising, or prescribing for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition under the provisions of this chapter.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice as a physician assistant" means the professional activities and conduct of a physician assistant, also known as a PA, in diagnosing, treating, advising, or prescribing for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain, or other condition under the provisions of this chapter.

value: prescribing and administering controlled substances with DEA registration
methods_authorized.quote: A physician assistant may provide any medical services that are not specifically prohibited under this chapter or rules adopted under this chapter, and that are within the physician assistant's skills and scope of competence.

drug_authority.value: A physician assistant may prescribe or administer controlled substances with a Utah controlled substance license and DEA registration; may also prescribe, order, administer, and procure drugs and medical devices within scope of practice; may dispense drugs if permitted by the Pharmacy Practice Act and within scope.
drug_authority.quote: A physician assistant may prescribe or administer an appropriate controlled substance that is within the physician assistant's scope of practice if the physician assistant holds a Utah controlled substance license and a DEA registration.

collaboration_hours_threshold_initial.quote: engage in collaboration with a physician for the first 4,000 hours of the physician assistant's post-graduate clinical practice experience.
collaboration_hours_threshold_initial.citation: Section 307 - Collaboration requirements -- Clinical practice experience -- Requirements for independent practice in a new specialty.

collaboration_hours_threshold_independen.quote: A physician assistant with less than 10,000 hours of post-graduate clinical practice experience shall: (a) practice under written policies and procedures established at a practice level
collaboration_hours_threshold_independen.citation: Section 307 - Collaboration requirements -- Clinical practice experience -- Requirements for independent practice in a new specialty.

written_collaborative_agreement_required.quote: a physician assistant who has more than 4,000 hours of practice experience and less than 10,000 hours of practice experience shall enter into a written collaborative agreement
written_collaborative_agreement_required.citation: Section 307 - Collaboration requirements -- Clinical practice experience -- Requirements for independent practice in a new specialty.

new_specialty_collaboration_hours_requir.quote: A physician assistant who wishes to change specialties to another specialty in which the PA has less than 4,000 hours of experience shall engage in collaboration for a minimum of 4,000 hours with a physician who is trained and experienced in the specialty to which the physician assistant is changing.
new_specialty_collaboration_hours_requir.citation: Section 307 - Collaboration requirements -- Clinical practice experience -- Requirements for independent practice in a new specialty.

temporary_license_available.quote: An applicant for licensure as a physician assistant who has met all qualifications for licensure except passing an examination component as required in Section 58-70a-302, may apply for and be granted a temporary license to practice

temporary_license_max_days.quote: The temporary license shall be issued for a period not to exceed 120 days to allow the applicant to pass the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination.

mental_health_specialty_credential_avail.quote: A physician assistant specializing in mental health care under this section shall: (a) hold a valid license as a physician assistant under this chapter; (b) obtain and maintain a Certification of Added Qualification in psychiatry issued by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants
mental_health_specialty_credential_avail.citation: Section 501.1 - Qualifications for a physician assistant specializing in mental health care -- Rulemaking.

mental_health_specialty_clinical_hours_r.quote: A physician assistant specializing in mental health care under this section shall complete 10,000 hours of clinical practice in mental health.
mental_health_specialty_clinical_hours_r.citation: Section 501.1 - Qualifications for a physician assistant specializing in mental health care -- Rulemaking.

general_anesthesia_prohibited.quote: Except as provided in Subsections (c) through (e), a physician assistant may not administer general anesthetics.

minimal_sedation_authorized.quote: A physician assistant may perform minimal sedation anxiolysis if the procedure is within the physician assistant's scope of practice.

rapid_sequence_intubation_authorized_wit.quote: A physician assistant may perform rapid sequence induction for intubation of a patient if: (i) the procedure is within the physician assistant's scope of practice; (ii) the physician assistant holds a valid ALS/ACLS certification and is credentialed and privileged at the hospital where the procedure is performed

neurostimulation_neuromodulation_restric.quote: A physician assistant may not administer neurostimulation or neuromodulation. (b) Subsection (4)(a) does not apply to neurostimulation or neuromodulation administered by a physician assistant: (i) in a health care facility; and (ii) under supervision of a physician whose usual scope of practice includes neurostimulation or neuromodulation.
neurostimulation_neuromodulation_restric.citation: Section 501.2 - Scope of practice for a physician assistant specializing in mental health care.

document_authentication_authority.quote: A physician assistant may authenticate through a signature, certification, stamp, verification, affidavit, or endorsement any document that may be authenticated by a physician and that is within the physician assistant's scope of practice.

volunteer_practice_controlled_substance_.quote: Notwithstanding Subsection 58-70a-501(8), a physician assistant who is providing volunteer health services under this section may not issue a prescription to a patient for a controlled substance.

interstate_compact_participation.quote: The Participating States hereby create and establish a joint government agency and national administrative body known as the PA Licensure Compact Commission.
interstate_compact_participation.citation: Section 107 - Section 7 -- Establishment of the PA Licensure

compact_privilege_nccpa_certification_re.quote: To exercise the Compact Privilege, a Licensee must: ... 2. Hold current NCCPA certification.

suicide_prevention_training_required_for.quote: Prior to license renewal, each licensee shall, during each two-year licensure cycle or other cycle defined by division rule: (a) view a suicide prevention video described in Section 58-1-601 and submit proof in the form required by the division

criminal_background_check_required.quote: consent to, and complete, a criminal background check, described in Section 58-1-301.5
